deities: Lord Shiva as Sri Uma Markandeyeswara (Markandeswara Swamy)

history.summary: Shiva temple on Godavari Bund Road near Pushkar Ghat, Mangalavaripeta, dedicated to Lord Shiva as Markandeswara and associated with the sage Markandeya; legend links the spot to Muni Mrukhananda/Mrikandu, whose son Markandeya was granted long life by Shiva. Exact founding date unknown and conflicting claims on the web are unverified: ~200 years old (local accounts), ~1,000 years, and a 1513 AD construction by Sri Krishnadevaraya; the main sanctum was rebuilt in 2018. Coordinates are approximate (no POI match; temple sits on the bund road near Pushkar Ghat).

name: Markandeya Temple
town_description: Rajamahendravaram (Rajahmundry), on the east bank of the Godavari in East Godavari district, is one of the oldest cities of Andhra Pradesh. It was the 11th-century seat of Eastern Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra and the birthplace of Telugu literature under the poet Nannaya. It is famed for its riverside ghats and Godavari Pushkarams, the Dowleswaram Barrage, paper mills and nurseries.

travel.road: APSRTC and private buses from Rajamahendravaram, Visakhapatnam and Bhadrachalam; taxis available

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Maha Shivaratri is the grandest occasion (expect long darshan queues)
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-9:00 PM (some sources say 8:00 PM close - verify)
